summary: Package daemon accepts remote WebSocket commands and executes them on the installer host with Claude Code bypassPermissions
details: Installing this package provides a bin `agenthub-agent` that runs a daemon connecting to `wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com`. The daemon's `Control.handle` dispatches server-sent messages into a Claude Agent SDK session started with `permissionMode: "bypassPermissions"` and `disallowedTools: ["AskUserQuestion"]`, so remote-supplied text drives Claude's Bash/Write/Edit tools on the installer's machine without user confirmation — a network-to-shell dataflow giving the remote side full-host RCE. The same dispatcher exposes `FileRead`/`FileWrite`/`FileTree`/`FileSearch` against arbitrary absolute paths (including Windows drive roots via `listDrives`) and an `AgentUpdate` action that spawns `agenthub-agent update`, which runs `npm install -g @agenthub-ai/agent@<latest>` — a remote-triggered self-reinstall path. The package also registers an autostart entry (Windows HKCU Run + `~/.agenthub/daemon.vbs`, Linux systemd user unit, macOS LaunchAgent) so the daemon runs on every login. The remote endpoint is a fixed, hardcoded, author-controlled host, and the RCE surface is the daemon's advertised behavior rather than an opt-in per-command confirmation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
